title: Executive / Senior Executive – Accounts & Finance
description:
**We Are Hiring: Executive / Senior Executive – Accounts \& Finance** 
  





  




**Location: Adibatla,** 
 Hyderabad
   

**Salary:** 
 ₹35,000 – ₹40,000 per month
   

**Qualification:** 
 MBA – Finance preferred
   

**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
   


  




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Accounts \& Finance professional** 
 with hands\-on knowledge of
 **SAP, Accounts Receivable, GST/TDS, reconciliations, invoicing and MIS reporting** 
 .
   

  

  


**Key Responsibilities:** 
  




* Accounting of incoming payments, manual JVs, adjustment entries, payroll JVs and statutory payments in
 **SAP** 
 .
* Manage
 **Accounts Receivable** 
 , AR ageing, customer outstanding follow\-ups, collection reports and customer ledger reconciliations.
* Prepare
 **TDS workings** 
 , payment entries and quarterly filing data.
* Handle
 **GST activities** 
 , including GSTR\-1 workings and GSTR\-2B reconciliation with books.
* Verify and account AP bills, import invoices, credit card transactions and fixed expenses.
* Prepare
 **Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS)** 
 and other account reconciliations.
* Generate sales/service invoices, credit notes, IRNs and E\-Way Bills.
* Handle accounting and invoicing related to
 **SEZ/NSEZ and DTA transactions** 
 .
* Create GLs, vendors, customer ledgers and work orders in SAP as required.
* Prepare weekly/monthly
 **Finance MIS, collection and outstanding reports** 
 and coordinate with Sales/customers for payment\-related matters.


 Requirements
   

  

**Required Skills:**
 SAP \| Accounts Receivable \| GST \| TDS \| BRS \| General Ledger \| Reconciliation \| Invoicing \| MIS Reporting \| MS Excel
   

  

  


 Candidates should have good communication skills in
 **English, Hindi and Telugu** 
 .
   





**Immediate joiners / candidates currently serving notice / short\-notice candidates will be preferred.** 
  




 Note: Answer the assessment questions to getting a response.
   

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

* 5 Day Work Week
* Bus Facility
* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Leave Encashment
